svg.text: A type error occurs whenever a candidate's box misses the target intersection.
For inputs a = 12 (2²·3¹) and b = 8 (2³·3⁰), target type Gcd(12, 8) requires Div(g) = {1, 2, 4} (box [0, 2] × [0, 0]). Every other point fails.
Divides a = 12, but fails to divide b = 8
Divides b = 8, but fails to divide a = 12
